biographie.texteParcours: Trained in the Mouride tradition through the teachings of Cheikh Ahmadou Bamba Mbacké, the Guide has devoted his life to passing on religious knowledge and to the spiritual support of the community.
biographie.texteVision: To bring the faithful together around the values of piety, work and solidarity carried by the Khidma, in continuity with the Cheikh's teaching.
biographie.texteEnseignements: The Guide emphasises the daily practice of faith, the education of young people and mutual support within the Dahira, through talks, advice and answers to members' questions.
